Tests {@link XXHash32} by hashing real resource files and comparing the result against reference checksums produced by the {@code xxh32sum} tool (see xxHash).
Buffer size used when reading a test resource fully into memory.

Supplies the parameters for the tests: a classpath resource to hash and the hexadecimal xxHash32 checksum expected for that resource. @return one {@link Arguments} per resource: (resource path, expected hex checksum).

Resolves a classpath resource to a file system path. @param resourcePath the classpath location of the resource. @return the resolved path on the file system. @throws Exception if the resource cannot be found or its URL cannot be converted.
Reads the whole input stream into a byte array. @param input the stream to drain. @return the stream contents as a byte array. @throws IOException if reading fails.
Hashes a resource in a single {@code update} call and verifies the checksum.

Hashes a resource through several incremental {@code update} calls and verifies that the checksum still matches the single-shot result. This also exercises {@link XXHash32#reset()} and the no-op for a negative length.
Feed one byte, then reset, so the upcoming hash starts from a clean state.
Feed the data in chunks: first byte, middle bytes, last byte.
A negative length must be ignored and leave the hash unchanged.
